expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Finds a reflected function on this class by name. Returns whether this class equals or derives from Other. Returns whether the class has the abstract class flag. Returns the immediate superclass. Finds a loaded class by reflected object name. Collects all loaded classes. @param OutClasses Receives the loaded class handles. Returns loaded subclasses of Class. @param bIncludeAbstractClasses Includes abstract subclasses when true. Returns the source file that declares a script function, or an empty string. Returns the source line that declares a script function. Returns the AngelScript declaration for a script function.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result. Verify size, element values, ordering, and empty result behavior that apply to the listed overloads.
inputs: Known positive and negative receiver states, empty/default state, exact lookup keys, and boundary values implied by the listed signatures.
testScope: UFunction UClass.FindFunctionByName(FName InFunctionName) const; | bool UClass.IsChildOf(UClass Other) const; | bool UClass.IsAbstract() const; | UClass UClass.GetSuperClass() const; | UClass UClass::FindClass(const FString& Name); | void UClass::GetAllClasses(TArray<UClass>& OutClasses); | TArray<UClass> UClass::GetAllSubclassesOf( UClass Class, bool bIncludeAbstractClasses = false); | FString UFunction.GetSourceFilePath() const; | int UFunction.GetSourceLineNumber() const; | FString UFunction.GetScriptFunctionDeclaration() const;
